item.description: Industry notice regarding the use of DMSO [UPDATED 19/2/2026] Recent stable inspections conducted by Racing NSW have identified the possession and use of industrial-grade dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) products such as Pharmachem DMSO within licensed Thoroughbred racing stables.
